test_item_verbatim: When the rear images are displayed on TLM_Display.GUI the setted brightness must be over 50%, in order to visualize better the images

tcs.tc_title: brightness off-point, set the display brightness to 49 % and check that the level is reported as below the requirement
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The HU display brightness is set to 49 %
4. No camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts = 1 (Inserted)
2. Measure the brightness of the displayed rear image on the HU display
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts = 1 (Inserted) is sent and the rear image is displayed
2. The measured brightness is 49 %, which is below the 50 % required by the source
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.test_item:
When the rear images are displayed on TLM_Display.GUI the setted brightness must be over 50%, in order to visualize better the images

(brightness off-point, set the display brightness to 49 % and check that the level is reported as below the requirement)

reasoning: 同 `-244` 之補生成依據；本列取**下界之 off-point 49 %**。**出兩列而非一列之由**：下放包 CAM-24 §2 明載「49% 併入同列之對照步**不可**（§8.3）」，故依其指示分列。**惟本 feature 既有之前例為一列兩點** —— `NR1L-RVCHMI-036`（§7.5.3 之 8 mph，一列內 205／206 兩步）與 `-111`（pinch in／out）皆為一列，且已判過；兩種形制之取捨請分析層裁（見上繳 §7-1）。來源只寫 `must be over 50%` 而**未載低於門檻時之系統行為**，故本列之 ER 只判**量得之值低於門檻**，**不造「影像不顯示」之判準**（§8.4.1）。
